hypothesis: The length-weight constant k = W/L^3 varies systematically with length during growth, revealing changes of form.
pass_criterion: Within species, the slope of log W on log L differs from 3.0 by more than 0.1 (95% CI excluding 3) in at least 70% of species.
fail_criterion: Slope within 3.0 +/- 0.05 for at least 70% of species, i.e. k is constant.
interpretation: k is the Fulton condition factor. The claim that k tracks form change is tested as k varying with L, which could also reflect condition rather than form.

dataset.name: DATRAS (the Database of Trawl Surveys)
dataset.publisher: International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES)
dataset.why_it_fits: Raw trawl survey data include individual fish length and weight in the biological records, though I did not confirm the exact fields.
